message: I am trapped in a flooded area
Water level rising near the village
Mother, I am safe. I am near the school.
Avoid the main road. It is flooded.
I am safe and waiting at the shelter.
Elderly man having severe chest pain at House 45, River Street. Need immediate medical help.
Roof collapsed in storm, three people buried under debris near Old Mill Road.
Water level reaching 2nd floor, cannot open door, trapped inside!
Pregnant woman in active labor at Community Center. No power or transport available.
Boat capsized near North Bridge. 4 people clinging to trees in swift current.
Child injured by fallen timber, bleeding heavily. Need urgent paramedic support.
Smoke filling apartment on 3rd floor, stairwell blocked by debris.
Asthma attack, inhaler ran out. Severe breathing difficulty at Block B shelter.
Flash flood swept away ground floor wall. Trapped on rooftop with 5 neighbors.
Water level rising rapidly near the village dike. Spillway overflowing.
Main power transformer sparks and downed live wires on West Avenue.
Landslide blocking main evacuation highway near Mile 14. Vehicles trapped.
Gas leak odor strong near Central Market area. Avoid ignition sources.
Bridge on East River showing structural cracks. Do not cross.
Storm surge breaking sea wall near Fisherman Colony.
Drinking water pump station submerged. Water supply contaminated.
Tree fell on high-voltage power line near City Hospital emergency entrance.
Sub-station flood alarm triggered. Area power grid cutoff imminent.
Fuel station wall collapsed, potential chemical spill in Sector 9.
Dad, we evacuated to St. Mary High School shelter. All of us are uninjured.
Priya, reached the relief camp. Kids are sleeping. Call when signal returns.
Searching for Uncle Ramesh. Last seen near Railway Colony during evacuation.
Aunt Sunita, we have clean drinking water and blankets at the stadium.
Grandma is safe with us at the municipal gym. Doctor checked her blood pressure.
Ankit, stayed back at house upper deck. House is dry. Will text again at noon.
Looking for my brother Vikrant, red jacket, last seen near West Bus Stand.
Wife and baby safe at Sector 3 Relief Depot. Don't risk travelling.
Grandpa's medication secured. We are heading to the North relief hub.
EVACUATION ORDER: All residents of Low-Lying River Banks move to Central Stadium immediately.
Clean drinking water and warm food packets being distributed at Town Hall.
Medical response unit deployed at Sector 5 Elementary School.
Boil water advisory in effect for North District due to flood runoff.
Emergency Mesh Node activated at High School Tower. Send messages via SAHARA.
Cyclone landfall expected in 2 hours. Stay indoors away from windows.
Relief helicopters operating near East Field for air-drop supplies.
Volunteers needed for food packaging at Central Community Kitchen.
Road to District Hospital cleared for emergency vehicles only.
Shelter 4 has reached capacity. Redirection to Shelter 5 in progress.
Solar charging station operating at 80% at Relief Camp B.
Water level receding on Main Street, but mud accumulation heavy.
Mobile mesh bridge battery level at 75%. Relay operational.
First aid kit delivered to Community Center Room 102.
Group of 15 evacuees resting at High School Auditorium.
Generator power restored for emergency lighting at Sector 2 Camp.
Rain stopped in North Zone. Wind speeds lowering.
